title: WiFi Connection Issues
question_pattern: wifi not working cannot connect no internet slow connection
answer:
Here are steps to fix WiFi issues:

1. Restart your router (unplug 30 secs).
2. Forget and reconnect to the WiFi network.
3. Check if other devices can connect.
4. Update or reinstall your network adapter drivers.
5. Reset network settings on your device.
6. Try using mobile hotspot or another network.

If the issue persists, there may be ISP or router hardware problems.

title: Laptop Won't Turn On
question_pattern: laptop not turning on power button no display dead
answer:
If your laptop won't turn on:

1. Check the charger and power outlet.
2. Remove battery (if removable) and do a power drain (hold button 30–60 secs).
3. Observe LED lights or fan activity.
4. Try external monitor to check for display failure.
5. Remove external devices (USB, HDMI).

If still dead, it's likely a battery, motherboard, or power IC issue.

title: Printer Not Printing
answer:
To fix printer printing issues:

1. Make sure printer is powered on with ink/paper.
2. Check USB cable/WiFi connection.
3. Clear print queue.
4. Update printer drivers.
5. Restart printer and print spooler service.
6. Perform a test print.
7. Check printer display for error messages.

If it still won't print, test the printer on another device.

title: Application Crashes
question_pattern: app crashing closing unexpectedly software not responding
answer:
If an application keeps crashing:

1. Restart the app.
2. Update to the latest version.
3. Restart your device.
4. Clear cache or temporary data.
5. Check system requirements.
6. Reinstall the application.
7. Close apps that may conflict.

If it still crashes, it may be due to corrupted files or system compatibility.

title: Password Reset
question_pattern: forgot password cannot login reset password account
answer:
To reset your password:

1. Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page.
2. Enter your email or username.
3. Check your inbox or spam folder.
4. Click the reset link.
5. Create a new secure password.

If no email arrives, contact IT support.

title: Slow Laptop Performance
question_pattern: laptop slow lagging freezing performance issue
answer:
To fix slow or lagging laptops:

1. Close unused apps and browser tabs.
2. Restart the device.
3. Check storage — free at least 15% space.
4. Disable startup programs.
5. Run a virus/malware scan.
6. Update Windows/macOS.
7. Upgrade RAM or SSD for long-term improvement.

title: Mobile Device Overheating
question_pattern: phone overheating hot device temperature high
answer:
If your phone is overheating:

1. Close apps running in background.
2. Remove case temporarily.
3. Avoid charging while playing games.
4. Disable hotspot, Bluetooth, GPS.
5. Let it rest in a cool area.

Persistent overheating may indicate battery or hardware issues.

title: Blue Screen of Death (BSOD)
question_pattern: blue screen bsod crash windows error
answer:
For Windows BSOD issues:

1. Restart your computer.
2. Disconnect newly attached hardware.
3. Update drivers and Windows.
4. Run Memory Diagnostic.
5. Run System File Checker (sfc /scannow).
6. Check disk (chkdsk).

If BSOD continues, backup files and bring for diagnostics.

title: No Sound / Audio Not Working
question_pattern: no sound audio not working speaker issue
answer:
If audio is not working:

1. Check volume and mute.
2. Switch output device (speaker/headset).
3. Restart device.
4. Update audio drivers.
5. Test with wired/wireless headphones.
6. Check if audio service is running.

If still no sound, audio hardware may be failing.

title: Cannot Install an Application
answer:
If you can't install an app:

1. Check if storage is enough.
2. Verify file compatibility (.exe/.apk/etc.).
3. Allow installation from trusted sources.
4. Restart device.
5. Disable antivirus temporarily.
6. Ensure your OS meets requirements.

If it still fails, the installer may be corrupted.

title: Keyboard Not Working
question_pattern: keyboard not working keys not typing unresponsive
answer:
If your keyboard isn't working:

1. Restart your device.
2. Try another USB port (for wired keyboards).
3. For wireless, replace batteries or recharge.
4. Clean keys and remove debris.
5. Reinstall keyboard drivers.
6. Test an external keyboard.

If the internal keyboard fails but external works, it's a hardware issue.

title: Mouse Not Working
question_pattern: mouse not working cursor not moving
answer:
Steps to fix a non-working mouse:

1. Try a different USB port.
2. Replace batteries (wireless).
3. Clean the mouse sensor.
4. Restart device.
5. Update mouse drivers.
6. Test with a different mouse.

If only your mouse fails, the issue may be with its hardware.

title: Screen Flickering
question_pattern: screen flickering display flashing monitor issue
answer:
To fix screen flickering:

1. Restart device.
2. Update display drivers.
3. Adjust refresh rate.
4. Check loose cable connections.
5. Test with external monitor.

If flickering continues, the backlight or ribbon cable may be failing.

title: Laptop Overheating
question_pattern: laptop overheating too hot high temperature
answer:
If your laptop is overheating:

1. Clean vents and fans.
2. Use on a flat, hard surface.
3. Close heavy applications.
4. Check Task Manager for high CPU usage.
5. Replace thermal paste (advanced).

Severe overheating may lead to auto shutdowns.

title: Black Screen / No Display
question_pattern: black screen no display monitor blank
answer:
If screen is black:

1. Check brightness.
2. Ensure power cable and display cable are connected.
3. Try external monitor.
4. Reseat RAM.

If external monitor works, the laptop display or cable may be damaged.

title: Bluetooth Not Connecting
answer:
If Bluetooth won’t connect:

1. Restart device.
2. Toggle Bluetooth off/on.
3. Remove and repair device.
4. Ensure devices are within range.
5. Update Bluetooth drivers.

Some devices cannot connect to multiple devices at once.

title: Microphone Not Working
question_pattern: microphone not working cannot record mic issue
answer:
If your mic is not working:

1. Check if muted.
2. Select correct input device.
3. Allow apps microphone permissions.
4. Update audio drivers.
5. Test with voice recorder.

If still not working, try external microphone.

title: Cannot Access Play Store
question_pattern: cannot access play store app store not loading
answer:
If Play Store/App Store won't load:

1. Check internet connection.
2. Clear cache and data.
3. Restart device.
4. Correct date and time.
5. Update system.

If still not loading, servers may be down.

title: USB Not Detected
question_pattern: usb not detected no response flash drive not reading
answer:
If a USB device is not detected:

1. Try different port.
2. Try USB on another device.
3. Update chipset/USB drivers.
4. Check Disk Management for recognition.

If unreadable on all devices, the drive may be corrupted.
